name: lens-reader
description: The /lens Reader lens: a third-party extractor's opinion of a page, served from its own Worker so the site bundle never carries a DOM.
$comment: Every wrangler script passes -c wrangler.toml EXPLICITLY. Without it wrangler walks UP the tree, finds the ROOT wrangler.jsonc, and runs its build.command (`node scripts/build.mjs`) from this directory, dying with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a file that only exists at the repo root. CI's steps for cf-garage and lwe-ask have always passed -c for that reason, so the flag looks like ceremony until you drop it: `bun run deploy` then fails in a way no CI run can catch, because CI never invokes these scripts.
$comment:workspace: lens-reader stays OUT of the root package.json `workspaces` array on purpose: readability + linkedom are megabytes that only this Worker bundles. Under pnpm that required `pnpm install --ignore-workspace`, because a bare install walked UP to pnpm-workspace.yaml, installed the five workspace projects, and never created lens-reader/node_modules at all — its tests then died on ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (gotcha 29). bun HAS NO SUCH FLAG and does not need one: measured 2026-08-16, a plain `bun install` here resolved this package.json alone, wrote lens-reader/bun.lock, and installed 21 packages into lens-reader/node_modules. Do not add a flag looking for parity; there is nothing to preserve.
